name: Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph
oracle_text:
Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
Three Autostubs — Whenever another source you control deals exactly 1 damage to a permanent or player, Ghyrson Starn deals 2 damage to that permanent or player.
blocked_sentences: Three Autostubs — Whenever another source you control deals exactly 1 damage to a permanent or player, Ghyrson Starn deals 2 damage to that permanent or player.

needs.what: a damage trigger that fires once per recipient (permanent or player) of damage dealt by any source matching a dealer filter ("another source you control", spells and abilities included), exposing that recipient's own share of the damage as a binding (to compare == 1) and the recipient itself as a binding a damage op can point at ("that permanent or player")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `deals_damage` has the dealer as subject but folds every recipient of one damage event into a single firing (`_joins_damage_dealt` sums `amount`), so a 1-damage share beside a larger one reads as the total and no binding names the recipient; `dealt_damage` fires per victim but only for permanents, and its `damaged_by` filter takes only `self` or an oid, so it cannot say "another source you control"; `deals_damage_to_player` covers only the player half, and splitting the one printed sentence across two triggers is not a faithful single ability
